# Test your node

## Summary

This section contains information about testing your node.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/connect/create-nodes/test-your-node.md

---

This section contains information about testing your node. You can test nodes manually and automatically. You should use both testing methods before publishing your node.

## In this section

* [Run your node locally](/connect/create-nodes/test-your-node/run-your-node-locally): manually test your node on your own machine, within a local n8n instance.
* [Node linter](/connect/create-nodes/test-your-node/node-linter): automatically test your node against n8n's linting rules.
* [Troubleshooting](/connect/create-nodes/test-your-node/troubleshooting): common issues you might encounter, and how to fix them.
